}}'''Nevin''' was a man from [[Ebou Dar]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Nevin}} He was possibly of noble birth.

==Activities==
Nevin was killed by [[Beslan]] in a duel. Beslan now has to go to [[Davindra]], his widow, and pay condolences.
